# Vercel v0 brief — Smart Writer V2 chat UI (D5)

**Purpose:** Paste into [v0.app](https://v0.app) (or equivalent). Generated by the lab orchestrator from locked spec + current `web/` surface — not from chat memory alone.

**Fidelity:** Open Decision **D5** = design with **Vercel v0**, then deploy on **Railway**. Do **not** accept “v0-class in-repo” as a substitute for this pass.

**After v0:** Export / copy into `apps/smart-writer-v2/web/`; keep BFF at `app/api/proxy/[...path]/route.ts` (browser never sees audit secret). Cattle for Railway UI may already exist uncommitted (`Dockerfile`, `deploy/railway/production/smart-writer-v2-ui.yml`) — wire after design lands.

---

## Prompt (copy below the line into v0)

---

Build a **Next.js App Router** single-page **writing chat product** called **Smart Writer** (grant / proposal writing beachhead). Desktop + mobile. Production look: calm, editorial, high SNR — not generic purple SaaS, not dashboard chrome, not emoji clutter.

### Primary layout (one composition)

1. **Header** — product name “Smart Writer” as the strongest brand signal; secondary: Settings control; optional status line (idle / sending / job status).
2. **Main split (desktop):**
   - **Left / primary:** conversational thread (user + assistant messages).
   - **Right / secondary:** **complete draft artifact** pane (full proposal body when a write job succeeds). Empty state: short guidance (“Send a grant prompt to draft”).
3. **Compose strip (bottom of chat):** multiline input + Send. Supporting (not hero): optional “criteria / materials URL” field; **Regenerate / start over** as an **explicit** control (toggle or button) — not inferred from prose.
4. **Settings** — slide-over or panel (not an in-chat interview). First preference: **Citation format** = Sources panel (default) | Inline | Footnotes | Panel + inline. Copy: “Applies on next send. Citation UI hides when a draft has no sources.” Leave room for future prefs.
5. **Property chips** (optional light correction) — closed set only, multi-select style: factual, persuasive, concise, warm, formal, humorous, specific, urgent. Free-form chat remains primary; chips are secondary.
6. **Sources presentation** (only when sources exist):
   - **panel / combo:** list/panel of sources (title, kind, link if any).
   - **footnotes:** footnote-style list under the draft.
   - **inline:** markers in/near draft; do not force a separate panel.
   - **no sources:** hide citation chrome entirely.

### States to design (wireframes / components)

| State | What user sees |
|-------|----------------|
| Fresh session | Empty thread + empty draft pane + compose ready |
| Clarify turn | Assistant asks specific missing questions in-thread (natural language — never “Axis A”, “intent_slots”, “whom” as field labels) |
| Write job running | Clear busy/status; draft pane unchanged until success |
| Draft ready | Full artifact body in draft pane; sources per citation setting |
| Revise | User feedback in thread; next draft replaces/improves prior artifact |
| Regenerate | Explicit control → fresh generate (new chain), not silent re-init |
| Settings open | Citation preference only for now |

### Hard constraints

- Browser talks **only** to same-origin `/api/...` (BFF). **Never** show or ask for an API/audit secret in the UI.
- No mandatory multi-step “citation interview” each turn — Settings only.
- No user-visible forms for internal grant slots; free-form first.
- Prefer one job per section; avoid card soup, pill clusters, stat strips.
- Accessible: labels, focus, `aria-expanded` on Settings.

### Tech preferences for v0 output

- Next.js App Router, React client components where needed for chat state.
- CSS modules or a single globals stylesheet; expressive fonts (not Inter/Roboto/system default stack as the hero voice).
- Keep structure mappable to: chat thread, artifact pane, compose form, Settings panel, property chips, sources panel/footnotes.

### Out of scope for this v0 pass

- Auth/login screens, billing, multi-workspace admin.
- File-upload dropzone polish (upload lands soon; a subtle “attach later” affordance is OK but not required).
- Marketing landing page / hero marketing site.
- Implementing the FastAPI worker — UI shell + states only.

### Deliverable

A polished App Router page (and components) matching the layout and states above, ready to drop into an existing repo that already has a BFF proxy route.
